chunks.text: Separate 2020 from 2021 model reviews please!. The 2021 model is a downgrade from the 2020 Moto G Power. (Do just a little homework & you'll read why.) Amazon should not be lumping their reviews together, as they have different specs and this is misleading to customers reading the reviews. I am pleased with my 2020 model Moto G Power. I feel it's a good value and quality for the money. Particularly pleased with the storage space. If you play games with any graphics intensity at all, know that the 3-day battery claim will not apply. I found that to be a disappointment, given how much battery life is hyped for the Moto G Power. I really only get a full day, maybe, out of the battery if I game a lot that day. If I hardly game at all, I think I get maybe a day & a half to 2 days, at a stretch.

Awesome Moto G Fast with Android v10. Upgraded from the Moto G5 Plus to the Moto G Fast (just out in June 2020). The phone is slightly larger than the G5, but it's lightning fast, easy to learn to use, three cameras, call screening!, and much much more. Overall, a solid phone with a modern OS, that won't disappoint.
Moto G Power 2020. Great phone! I love the long battery life. So many features and I have yet to use the facial recognition.

I Really Like This Phone. When I was looking to upgrade last year, I was comparing between this one (2020 Moto G Stylus) and the 2020 Moto G Power because they were both on sale and are pretty similar. I ended up choosing this one because of the more powerful camera. I really love it and I am very happy with my purchase.

Direct-to-ear call quality is as it should be but I avoid that so for me, the speakerphone is going to remain a real trade-off. But that’s the only drawback to the Moto G Stylus 2020, or perhaps just to phones with stereos speakers. In all other ways I’m finding the 2020 Moto G Stylus to be a mega value for anywhere near its price range.

This is really a great phone for the price.. I love my moto g power 2020. The speakers are loud. I actually have to turn it down. It is really fast, I play games on it , it doesn't crash and it loads fast. The battery life is great. I don't have to charge my phone every day. I charge my phone every 3 or 4 days.

A great budget phone, but the G Fast is still a better buy. This phone suits my needs. It has a nice matte finish, and it even gets though my tasks well. I give this device a good point for it's battery. However, the Moto G Fast, despite being a 2020 model, is still a better device in it's specs, so if you want those, get that instead. Otherwise, This is a great phone for essential users, and those who can't afford a flagship.
Battery doesn't last as long as the 2020 version.. My Moto G Power is a Great phone! BUT the 2021 is a BIG disappointment on the battery life! Doesn't last nearly as long; certainly not 3 days!

a reliable brand. Last October I purchased the 2020 Moto G Power for a friend. She had previously owned a Moto G5+ and after three years, the micro charge connection on that workhorse was weakening. I went on the Amazon to put a study on the latest from Motorola Android One unlocked. I read the reviews and specs on the 2020 G Power . The upgrade to the more robust type C charging port was noted. I ordered the 2020 Moto G Power and had it shipped to an Amazon drop where it arrived quickly and while my friend's old phone was still functional. The clerks at the facility helped her move the SIM card over, and transfer photos and files onto the new device. After restoring the navigation buttons, she became comfortable with the new phone. I've owned two Motorola phones myself and have recommended them to friends and family.
